recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Ask the responsible work group to decide whether an exclusive-patient Consent.provision extension is still wanted in the FHIR Extension Pack, or whether current Consent.provision.data, Consent.provision.expression, and Permission-based policy mechanisms supersede the STU3 proposal.
issue_request: FHIR-17569 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and requested a way to make a Consent provision specific to this patient and only this patient, with a proposed 0..1 Boolean Consent.provision.exclusive extension meaning only share information directly or exclusively about this patient.
initial_application: No durable source application was found. Searches for FHIR-17569, GF#17569, Consent.provision.exclusive, and the proposed wording found no active core definition, no release-branch definition in R4/R4B/R5 source, and no Extension Pack definition.
additional_context: Consent is active and approved in the current build. The current resource has provision.data.meaning and provision.expression, and later Consent redesign work such as FHIR-31029 added broader subject and computable rule support. Core Consent extension definitions were removed from R5 source, and the Extension Pack contains other Consent.provision extensions but not this Boolean.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. An empty human-review commit was published to record that adding a new core extension is not appropriate in the current build and that Extension Pack work or an explicit superseding decision needs CBCC/Security review.

related_jiras.note: Published R5 Consent redesign work added Group subject support and computable provision expression, affecting interpretation of the old Boolean extension request.
Applied request for Permission-based Consent provision representation shows ongoing Consent rule-model evolution but does not decide the exclusive-patient extension.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification Consent request to create a Consent.provision.exclusive Boolean extension for data exclusively about this patient.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the formal seed request, while the resolution itself leaves false and missing-value semantics partly unsettled.

evidence_items.summary: The current fhir.ini lists consent=Consent and marks Consent as approved.
evidence_items.learned: Consent source is in current core build scope, so the active Consent resource was the right source to inspect.

evidence_items.summary: Current Consent has provision.data, provision.data.meaning, provision.data.reference, and provision.expression, plus data meaning codes instance, related, dependents, and authoredby.
evidence_items.learned: Current core has broader data-scoping and computable-expression mechanisms that may cover related policy needs without recreating the old Boolean extension.
